privateBlenderPointReference.selection: Class 1 within 2 m of inherited building footprints; class 2 within 12 m. Class 1 does not identify a roof.
privateBlenderPointReference.renderPolicy: Vertex evidence only, hidden by default; no inferred roof faces. Use explicit scene RH2000 height-origin offset.

classification.1: Unclassified surface: roofs and vegetation not separated

method.planeFit: Deterministic RANSAC descriptive support, up to three planes, 0.25 m vertical residual threshold, minimum 16 points each; slope capped 61 degrees. No roof-type inference or current-geometry mutation.
method.groundHeight: Median of local class-2 annulus; terrain variation reported in quantiles, not fitted away.
method.currentElevationFrame: RH2000 absolute height, not legacy Terrarium world y

limitations: Laser capture 2021-04-17 predates the 2025 orthophoto by four years.
No class-6 building label exists in the bounded cloud: all candidates remain class-1 surface returns.
Tree branches, roof overhang, footprint misregistration, chimneys and sparse returns can affect quantiles.
Adjacent ground is sloping in parts of the estate; a median is not a survey floor level.
No measured eave or ridge heights are claimed; use planar support and current facade photos together.
No course runtime geometry or height data has been changed.
